items.source: Factory method to create a new AotApplicationContextInitializer instance that delegates to other initializers loaded from the given set of class names.
items.translation: 用于创建新AotApplicationContextInitializer实例的工厂方法，该实例将委托给从给定类名集加载的其他初始化器。

items.source: Instances of this initializer are usually created using forInitializerClasses(String...), passing in the names of code generated initializer classes.
items.translation: 此初始化器的实例通常使用 forInitializerClasses(String...) 创建，并传入代码生成的初始化器类的名称。
一个新的AotApplicationContextInitializer实例

items.source: initializerClassNames - the class names of the initializers to load
items.translation: initializerClassNames - 要加载的初始化器的类名
C - 应用程序上下文类型

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
